commands.name: m116_boundary_wrong_history_surface_robustness_gate

decision_rule: Admit the M115 boundary-tightened wrong-history surface for objective training only if it is not dominated by duplicate source pairs or a single tuned boundary width and if wrong-history success drops remain visible under a held-out split.
failure_criteria: accepted wrong-history rows collapse after deduplicating source seed/step pairs
accepted rows require only one checkpoint or one source seed pair
wrong-history drops disappear under held-out target-normal-margin splits
reset or zero-current degradation is the only robust signal
hypothesis: M115 constructed a positive wrong-history success-drop surface, but the margins are very narrow and may be boundary-tuned. A robustness gate should verify the surface before training a new intervention objective.
success_criteria: M115 accepted rows are split by source pair or geometry target and evaluated on held-out rows
wrong-history success drops or mitigation degradation remain after deduplication
M62 remains a control rather than an admitted wrong-history surface
the result decides whether M117 should train a boundary-aware wrong-history objective
